accepted_behavior: append, query, explain, export-read, clear, and recovery share one monotonic acquisition budget across the per-store identity mutex and operating-system file lock
same-process, operating-system, and mixed contention expire with one deterministic typed timeout and do not reset the budget
public local query reports the typed timeout while preserving store bytes, recursive target state, Git status, and the zero-write read boundary
privacy, explicit deletion, bounded retention, and disabled external-export defaults remain fail closed
withheld: a deadline over filesystem I/O, decoding, durability synchronization, or lock-hold duration after acquisition
readiness release node closure and goal completion
claim_ceiling: sealed source-local event-store behavior with bounded lock acquisition and deterministic zero-write local query timeout
no_claim_statement: This acceptance does not claim external-adapter execution, installation, real-user operation, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
